column2: lsv2 dependency manifest -- target: Linux x86_64 with conda-forge, 2026-10-18
Tab-separated. Read and executed by conda.sh, which lives next to this file.
Lines starting with '#' are comments. Lines starting with '#!' are metadata
parsed by the script (they are NOT comments to the script).
To target a different machine: copy this file to deps.<host>.tsv, edit the
#!target line and the affected rows, then run
./conda.sh deps.<host>.tsv
No change to conda.sh should ever be needed to support a new host.
COLUMNS
stage      install order group; stages run in ascending order. Rows in
the same stage sharing installer+source+flags+required are
merged into ONE command so they resolve together.
package    distribution name as the installer knows it
version    'latest' | exact ('25.0.0') | range ('>=2.7')
Ignored when the source names an artifact outright (direct=,
git=, local=) -- the path or URL already pins it.
arch       platform tag this row was VALIDATED on. Documentation, not a
filter.
installer  'conda' | 'pip'
source     where the package comes from:
pip:   pypi | index=<url> | extra=<url> | links=<url> | direct=<url> | git=<url>@<ref> | local=<path>
conda: channel=<a>[,<b>] | nodefaults      (';'-separated, combine freely)
flags      extra installer flags, '-' for none
required   'yes' aborts on failure, 'no' warns and continues
note       why this row exists / why this pin
Versions below are the ones the 2026-10-17/18 validation ran on (conda list
of the environment that produced the first dataset). Everything comes from
conda-forge so that ffmpeg, x264 and PyAV are built against each other.
os=linux
lsv2

column9: What the validation ran on. Anything >= 3.12 should do (pyproject says so); re-validate if changed.

column2: numpy
column9: Range image arrays and the render formula (lsv2/render.py).

column2: pyarrow
column9: Reads the Waymo v2 parquet lidar component (lsv2/reader.py). Replaces TensorFlow and the official waymo-open-dataset package, which only ships x86_64 wheels.

column2: av
column9: PyAV: decodes clips back for the bit-exact check (lsv2/encoder.py); the same library MAE-ST reads the dataset with.

column2: ffmpeg
column9: Encoder (lsv2/encoder.py). conda-forge's default build is 'gpl' and includes libx264, which both profiles need; verify() checks libx264 and the gray pix_fmt.

column2: google-cloud-storage
column9: Lists and downloads segments from the Waymo bucket (lsv2/source/gcs.py).

column2: google-auth
column9: Loads the user-supplied credentials file (ADC or service account).

column2: pillow
column9: Only tests/test_oracle.py reads the legacy PNGs with it. Not needed to run.

column2: google-cloud-sdk
column9: Provides 'gcloud auth application-default login', the one-time step that writes the credentials file lsv2 consumes. 122 MB; the only reason it is here.

column2: tmux
column9: For long runs over SSH (README). Not a dependency.

column2: pyinstaller
column9: Only to build the self-contained executable with _bundle/build.sh. Not a dependency.

column2: lsv2
column9: The pipeline itself, editable, from the repository root (this file lives in <repo>/_install). Run conda.sh from <repo>/_install.
